This targets improving IC and MI while keeping the core mechanism unchanged.

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 21)), 1), divide(1, add(1, divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21), AdjClose)))), divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 21)))
  2. 2. multiply —— 乘法
    multiply(subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 21)), 1), divide(1, add(1, divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21), AdjClose))))
  3. 3. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 21)), 1)
  4. 4. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(AdjClose, ts_delay(AdjClose, 21))
  5. 5. ts_delay —— 滞后 N 天(取N天前值)
    ts_delay(AdjClose, 21)
  6. 6. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(1, add(1, divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21), AdjClose)))
  7. 7. add —— 加法
    add(1, divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21), AdjClose))
  8. 8. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21), AdjClose)
  9. 9. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 21)
  10. 10. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 21))
  11. 11. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 21)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 close：close
  2. 计算 high：high
  3. 计算 low：low
  4. 计算 volume：volume
  5. 计算 mom：close / close.shift(21) - 1
  6. 计算 atr：pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=21), index=df_copy.index)
  7. 计算 vol_gate：atr / close
  8. 计算 vol_sma：volume.滚动窗口(21, min_periods=21).mean()
  9. 计算 vol_ratio：volume / vol_sma
  10. 计算 factor：mom * (1 / (1 + vol_gate)) * vol_ratio
⚠ 该因子原始 IC 为负，已整体取反（×(-1)）调正方向；下列步骤展示的是原始公式的计算过程。

"kw">class="kw">def factor_vol_gated_momentum_v2(df): df_copy = df.copy() close = df_copy["str">'close'] high = df_copy["str">'high'] low = df_copy["str">'low'] volume = df_copy["str">'volume'] "com"># 21-day momentum mom = close / close.shift(21) - 1 "com"># 21-day ATR normalized by close "kw">class="kw">for volatility gate atr = pd.Series(talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=21), index=df_copy.index) vol_gate = atr / close "com"># Volume ratio to 21-day SMA (changed "kw">class="kw">from 63-day median "kw">class="kw">for shorter-term capture) vol_sma = volume.rolling(21, min_periods=21).mean() vol_ratio = volume / vol_sma.replace(0, np.nan) "com"># Core: momentum dampened by volatility, multiplied by continuous volume confirmation factor = mom * (1 / (1 + vol_gate)) * vol_ratio df_copy["str">'factor_vol_gated_momentum_v2'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_vol_gated_momentum_v2']
